newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Singapore rubber market was closed on Friday for a holiday. The market will reopen on Monday.
The market finished weakly on Thursday after a sharp fall in Japan sidelined players.
The June RSS3 contract closed on Thursday at 110.75 U.S. cents a kg from 112.50 cents. The June RSS1 contract ended at 158.75 Singapore cents (US$1.10) a kg from 160.75 cents.
The June TSR20 contract closed at 152.50 Singapore cents ($1.06) a kg from 154.00 cents. October/December TSR20 finished at 110.50 U.S. cents a kg from 112.00 cents.
